record.reason: BOSS uses LLM calls to propose/label skill chains during a robot-policy bootstrapping phase, then trains a language-conditioned policy and grows a skill library. It is an agent/robot learning workflow, not an optimization of LLM inference or a measured reduction in deployed LLM serving.
record.title: Bootstrap Your Own Skills: Learning to Solve New Tasks with Large Language Model Guidance
